meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把演示主题或现成网页变成可点击跳转的分支幻灯片,自带讲者备注
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做一份能点击跳转、带讲者备注的演示,而普通幻灯片不够用
copy.tagline_en: Turn a topic or web page into a branching clickable deck with speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clickable deck with speaker notes that plain slides can't deliver

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 编写幻灯片(演示、pitch deck 或交互式 deck),含离散页面、片段揭示、分支、热点导航和带演讲备注的演讲者模式;产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4,也能把现有页面转成 deck。
howto.when: 当你明确提出要幻灯片、pitch deck,或要求把页面转成 deck 时接管;若只是相邻说法(如“演示”),它会先说明这种幻灯片的含义,并确认要不要做。

say.text: 把这份 BRIEF 做成一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: 它会先确认,再开始搭建

say.text: 把这个页面转成可导航的 deck
say.note: 尽量保留原页面的设计和动效

say.text: 给这一页加个热点,点击跳到附页分支
say.note: 热点指向一个分支幻灯片序列

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: a deck with discrete slides, fragments, branching, hotspot navigation and presenter mode with notes. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4; it can also convert an existing page.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, pitch deck etc., or to convert a page into a deck; if the request is only adjacent, it explains and confirms first.

say_en.text: Turn this BRIEF into a HyperFrames slideshow.
say_en.note: It confirms first, then builds the deck.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a navigable deck.
say_en.note: Keeps the original design and motion where practical.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on this slide that jumps to an appendix branch.
say_en.note: The hotspot targets a branch slide sequence.
